name: Polyglyceryl-2 laurate
description: Polyglyceryl-2 laurate (CAS 96499-68-2 ), also sold under trade names such as Dermofeel G 2 L and Sunsoft Q-12D and known commercially as diglyceryl monolaurate, is a mild, plant-derived emulsifier and wetting agent. It enables stable oil-in-water emulsions across a broad range of personal care, food, and industrial formulations. In skincare and cosmetics, it functions as a primary or co-emulsifier in lotions and creams. It is frequently used in cleansing formulations where a gentle, skin-compatible surfactant profile is required. Food manufacturers use it to improve fat dispersion and texture in confectionery and bakery coatings. It is also utilized in processed food systems to enhance consistency. In home care and industrial cleaning products, it supports wetting and soil removal in mild-surfactant formulations targeting sensitive surfaces. Coatings and adhesive formulators incorporate it as a surface modifier to improve substrate wetting and emulsion stability. This versatile chemical is typically supplied as a liquid or paste depending on grade. Food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications are the most commonly traded forms, with supply aligned to non-GMO and natural or organic positioning where applicable for modern manufacturing standards. It is available in drum and IBC quantities suited to industrial procurement volumes.
